parsed.note_claim: Cigarettes contain up to 750x the amount of diacetyl than e-cigarettes do, and never caused popcorn lung.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: Daily exposure to diacetyl from smoking is therefore 750 times higher, on average, than exposure to diacetyl from vaping.
parsed.reason: The page explicitly validates the 750 times higher diacetyl comparison and states smoking has not been shown to be a risk factor for popcorn lung.
